statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while NQ is closed for the weekend; Stress remains high on unresolved Hormuz disruption, sanctions pressure and Friday’s hawkish rate repricing.
recommendation: Weekend conditions provide no live NQ path to establish persistent one-way continuation. The published state therefore reflects low Tail with high headline and reopening-gap Stress.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low as fresh Iran sanctions and Hormuz reporting sustain Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend. Reuters reported at 02:04 UTC that Iran’s foreign trade is down 35% under sanctions and blockade and that only seven commodity vessels crossed Hormuz on Thursday, below the recent average. Friday’s hawkish Fed repricing remains relevant, but no live futures path exists to establish persistent Tail behavior.
